hero.lead: Nils von Münster-Kistner brings together physiotherapy, anatomy and yoga practice — through in-person workshops and, soon, online courses. For anyone who wants to truly understand their body.

about.name: Nils von Münster-Kistner, MSc.
about.role: Physiotherapist & Yoga Teacher, Klagenfurt am Wörthersee
about.title: Where anatomy meets breath.
about.text1: Nils is a passionate physiotherapist and yoga teacher based in Klagenfurt am Wörthersee, Austria. His classes are shaped by his expertise in health, anatomy and rehabilitation — combining scientific insight with his yoga practice.
about.text2: He's committed to helping people understand their bodies holistically and unfold their full potential. Extensive further training in sports physiotherapy, visceral osteopathy, respiratory physiotherapy and biomechanics rounds out his background.
about.hobby: Outside of yoga, Nils is into Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, climbing and cycling.
